name: March
title: Where to go on holiday in March
intro: March is a month of in-betweens: winter sun is still going strong, the ski season has its sunniest weeks, and spring starts in places like Marrakech and Tokyo.
seo_title: Where to go on holiday in March: warm days and late snow

faqs.question: Where is warm in March?
faqs.answer: Further away, the Caribbean, Mexico, the Maldives and Sri Lanka are still in their dry season. Closer to the UK, Tenerife, Cape Verde and Marrakech are warm, though Marrakech's evenings are still cool.

faqs.question: When is cherry blossom in Tokyo?
faqs.answer: Usually from late March to early April, but it changes a little each year, so check the forecasts nearer the time. It's Tokyo's busiest season, so book well ahead.

faqs.question: Is March good for skiing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Chamonix and Whistler have long, sunny days and plenty of snow, and Easter is often cheaper than February half term if it falls early.
